summary:
The bad() entry point reads a 'data' value from a properties file and embeds it directly into the HTTP error message sent via response.sendError, allowing the value to be reflected into the HTML error page unescaped (CWE-81 XSS). The fix HTML-encodes the data before concatenating it into the error message, neutralizing any markup/script while leaving ordinary values displayed intact. The intentional surrounding '
' markup is preserved so the feature still renders normally.

edits.old:
response.sendError(404, "
bad() - Parameter name has value " + data);
edits.new:
String encodedData = data.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">").replace("\"", """).replace("'", "'"); response.sendError(404, "
bad() - Parameter name has value " + encodedData);
